title: xte W1: register cloudflare-sandbox in the CLI's honoured executors and decide collect/cancel/dispose
body: Parent xte; the FIRST tick of the repair wave. internal/cli/executor.go knownExecutors/executorFactory know only local-subprocess and herdr, so internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox is unreachable from run-epic and every cloudflare-sandbox profile is refused. Register it (Runners: pi; AcceptsModel; the cloud PollInterval) and settle where collect, cancel and dispose live (supersedes findings a35ff202 and a69a9747).
